name: Trigger
report: U.S.S. TRIGGER Report of Third War Patrol.

citation.nara_catalog_title: World War II War Diaries, Other Operational Records and Histories, compiled ca. 01/01/1942 - са. 06/01/1946, documenting the period ca. 09/01/1939 ca. 05/30/1946

arrival.label: Arrived
flags: Report: 'Arrived MIDWAY for refit.' Time not transcribed.
Time not recorded; placed at noon.

fields.event: Heavy seas. Making good only 8 knots.
Storms moderated. Making good 12 knots.
Rough again; 8 knots.

records.title: Narrative entry

fields.event: [SUMMARY] Sighted patrol freighter bearing 010 on horizon; turned away to develop submerged during day to avoid warning Japanese coast before undetected mine plant.

flags: lon: '147-48  .' missing longitude hemisphere in text; (1st Contact) (No Attack)

records.title: Narrative entry

fields.event: [SUMMARY] Submerged; freighter on station patrol changing courses, with special apparatus amidships, likely aircraft warning vessel; took photographs and cleared vicinity.

flags: zone: blank in '0454( )'
No zone letter on this entry; zone K assumed from the previous entry.

records.title: Narrative entry

fields.event: Sighted freighter to the south of INUBO SAKI on northerly course. Sho passed INUBO SAKI close aboard on about the 20 fathom curve.

flags: (2nd Contact) (No Attack); Mission is Reconnaissance.

records.title: Narrative entry

fields.event: Sighted freighter just to the south of INUBO SAKI on northerly courso. She also passed INUBO SAKI close aboard on about the 20 fathom curve.

flags: zone: blank in '1510( )'; 3rd Contact) (No Attack); Mission is Reconnaissanco.
No zone letter on this entry; zone K assumed from the previous entry.

records.title: Narrative entry

fields.event: Sichted froighter abreast of INUBO SAKI on southerly course, again near the 20 fathom curve.

flags: (4th Contact) (No Attack); Mission is Reconnaissanco.

records.title: Narrative entry

fields.event: Submerged preparatory to laying the mine fields.

flags: No position in the report. Placed on the track between the recorded positions at 1942-12-19 18:30 and 1942-12-20 13:18 GMT, as an estimate.

records.title: Narrative entry

fields.event: [SUMMARY] Decided to conclude reconnaissance and lay northern and southern mine fields submerged in moonlight after sunset perpendicular to ship courses off Inubo Saki.

flags: No position in the report. Placed on the track between the recorded positions at 1942-12-19 18:30 and 1942-12-20 13:18 GMT, as an estimate.

records.title: Narrative entry

fields.event: Commonced laying minos.

flags: No position in the report. Placed on the track between the recorded positions at 1942-12-19 18:30 and 1942-12-20 13:18 GMT, as an estimate.

records.title: Narrative entry

fields.event: Completed laying the first field.

flags: No position in the report. Placed on the track between the recorded positions at 1942-12-19 18:30 and 1942-12-20 13:18 GMT, as an estimate.

records.title: Narrative entry

fields.event: Commenced laying the second mine field.

flags: No position in the report. Placed on the track between the recorded positions at 1942-12-19 18:30 and 1942-12-20 13:18 GMT, as an estimate.

records.title: Narrative entry

fields.event: [SUMMARY] Sighted approaching freighter with small escort; ceased mine laying; vessels passed astern; violent explosion occurred five minutes later; 8400 ton freighter sunk by mines.

flags: (5th Contact) (1st Attack)
The report marks this entry (1st Attack) but it has no tag. Add tag: attack, gun or minefield.

records.title: Narrative entry

fields.event: [SUMMARY] Observed broken freighter sinking rapidly with main deck awash, escort circling; ship matched Aikoku-class types; began retirement to deep water.

flags: Entry text carries over from page 3 to page 4; heading on page 4 repeats as '2333(K) (Cont'd).'

fields.event: Another violent explosion. Nothing soon. Possibly another mino caught somcono, perhaps the escort vessel.
[SUMMARY] Screws picked up by sound; went deep and rigged for silent running and depth charge attack; successful evasion.
Surfaced and cleared the area at high speed.
Sightod a huge cloud of smoko from the mine fields.
On station on course line 312 to NOJIMA SAKI to intercept traffic from the southorst.
Surfaced and honded for NOJIMA SAKI at high speed to be off this point close in for the coming day's observation.
Commonced petrol off NOJIMA SAKI.

records.position_verbatim: about two miles 240 of NOJIMA SAKI

derived.landmark_note: Southern tip of the Boso Peninsula (lighthouse). Approximate; verify against a chart.

records.title: Narrative entry

fields.event: [SUMMARY] Fired torpedo spread on 90 track; one hit forward of bridge; target down by bow; Trigger turned away in shallow water near grounding.

flags: Time out of sequence (1333 follows 1336); entry ends mid-sentence at bottom of page 4
Read as 'bearing 240 from NOJIMA SAKI'. If the report means NOJIMA SAKI bore 240 from the boat, set bearing_is: to_landmark.
Position derived from 'about two miles 240 of NOJIMA SAKI' using a modern landmark position; it is an estimate, not a position recorded in the report.
Landmark: Southern tip of the Boso Peninsula (lighthouse). Approximate; verify against a chart.

records.title: Narrative entry

fields.event: [SUMMARY] Sighted freighter smoke in Uraga Suido zigzagging on ~60-degree legs; positioned to attack regardless of course.

flags: (6th Contact) (2nd Attack); time printed as 1336(K) before subsequent 1333(K) firing entry
The report marks this entry (2nd Attack) but it has no tag. Add tag: attack, gun or minefield.
